summary.zh: 规划依赖大版本升级并处理破坏性变更
summary.en: Plan major dependency bumps and breaking changes

description.zh: 先分析新旧版本的兼容差异，再分批升级并补齐测试，最后清理废弃用法。适合框架或核心库跨大版本更新、需要控制风险时。
description.en: Analyzes compatibility between versions, rolls upgrades out in stages, and covers breaking changes with tests. Use it when a framework or core library moves to a new major version.
